name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph with prioritized Town Shop Arbitrage, two-tier market liquidation, Capital Reinvestment scaling, protected shed liquidation floors, and cluster-harvesting dispatch sequencing.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Cyclical Peak Market Liquidation
nodes.description: Routinely liquidates unreserved inventory during cyclical market price peaks to maximize profit margins without waiting for shed overflow.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors while protecting animal feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into workforce acceleration (10-hand rush), contiguous land expansion, commercial high-yield seeds, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: harvest ready crops, worker drop-offs, watering, livestock feeding, planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 180.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) when surplus cash covers seed costs and wage buffers. Halt Pumpkin seed purchases after Day 23, Tomatoes after Day 25, and Carrots after Day 27.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if shed capacity exceeds 88%; never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch liquidations of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings when market prices hit cyclical peaks (>= 1.05x to 1.15x base price). Route deliverable produce to Town Shops first.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery. Do not sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3).

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.85 * base_price to prevent discard drops.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.85 base price; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never evict produce allocated for active town shop fulfillment.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.85 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.85 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= (midnight_payroll_due * 1.10 + 80.0 if day <= 8 else midnight_payroll_due * 1.35 + 250.0) and (hired_hands < 10 or uncultivated_plots <= 1 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Aggressively scale workforce to the 10-hand cap by early-to-mid game; purchase contiguous land plots whenever uncultivated_plots <= 1 to expand cultivation acreage; procure high-margin commercial seeds (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Strawberries) and fertilizer to maximize per-plot harvest throughput.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allocate reinvestment capital if net cash after purchase drops below the dynamic wage buffer; do not acquire land plots that hands cannot consistently water; halt land/hand capital expansion after day 26 to maximize terminal cash accumulation.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Harvest adjacent mature tiles until inventory >= 2 items or local cluster is clear; 2) Drop off carried items at shed (mandatory after hour 20); 3) Water dry crops; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Plant commercial seeds; 6) Weed clearing and ground tilling. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited at shed by step 716 for terminal liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never prioritize weeding over harvesting or watering; do not leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain. Avoid single-item drop-off trips before hour 20.
